test.description: The style contract tests read files outside this package, so those files are inputs too (issue #353): design-system.contract.test.ts reads DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, and mobile-tokens.contract.test.ts runs scripts/sync-mobile-design-tokens.mjs, which diffs globals.css against apps/mobile/src/styles/global.css and reads packages/mobile-ui/src/lib/design-tokens.ts (issue #516; @repo/mobile-ui is not a dependency of this package). The tailwind preset it also reads reaches the hash through the @repo/config#build edge.
